offering_description.value: LifeVantage sells dietary supplements and personal care products to consumers. It uses contract manufacturers and sells through independent consultants and its own website.

primary_products.value: dietary supplements; weight-management supplements; nutrition powders and drink mixes; skin care products; hair care products

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers shopping for supplements, weight-management products, and personal care

end_markets.value: consumer health and wellness; weight management; skin and hair care

revenue_model.value: product sales: one-time purchases of dietary supplements and personal care products; subscription: recurring deliveries of supplements and personal care products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops supplements and personal care products made by contract manufacturers for consumers; retailer: sells finished wellness products to consumers through its website

geography_served.value: global: North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: dietary supplements, weight-management products, and skin and hair care

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent direct-selling consultants who refer and sell to consumers; online: company-operated storefront with one-time and recurring orders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA rules for dietary supplements and cosmetics, plus FTC rules on advertising claims and direct selling

notes: Current availability of pet supplements is uncertain.
